{{Top|leg}}
'''Auditory dampeners''' were devices that muffled the sound produced by engines. The [[Arakyd Aerodynes, Inc.]] [[Hush-About AJP-400]] used specially designed auditory dampeners in conjunction with [[Sound baffler]]s to make the [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] virtually soundless.
